mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report ( room_id, overall_score, ai_comment, comp_expertise, comp_expertise_detail, comp_logic, comp_logic_detail, comp_commu, comp_commu_detail, comp_culture, comp_culture_detail, comp_pressure, comp_pressure_detail, speech_wpm, speech_filler ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{overallScore}, #{aiComment}, #{compExpertise}, #{compExpertiseDetail}, #{compLogic}, #{compLogicDetail}, #{compCommu}, #{compCommuDetail}, #{compCulture}, #{compCultureDetail}, #{compPressure}, #{compPressureDetail}, #{speechWpm}, #{speechFiller} )

INSERT INTO report_applicant (report_id, room_id, is_user, applicant_id, score, strength, weakness) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.roomId}, #{item.isUser}, #{item.applicantId}, #{item.score}, #{item.strength}, #{item.weakness})

INSERT INTO report_question (report_id, room_id, question_seq, question_text, answer_text, score, label, feedback, tags) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.roomId}, #{item.questionSeq}, #{item.questionText}, #{item.answerText}, #{item.score}, #{item.label}, #{item.feedback}, #{item.tags})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, room_id, overall_score, ai_comment, comp_expertise, comp_expertise_detail, comp_logic, comp_logic_detail, comp_commu, comp_commu_detail, comp_culture, comp_culture_detail, comp_pressure, comp_pressure_detail, speech_wpm, speech_filler, created_at FROM interview_report WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT id, report_id, room_id, question_seq, question_text, answer_text, score, label, feedback, tags FROM report_question WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY question_seq
